_comment: A SHA listed here overrides the heuristic permanently, and the change is
reviewable in git like any other edit. Add an entry whenever you know the
heuristic got a commit wrong — that is the mechanism by which this record
gets more accurate over time rather than less.
Buckets: ai-attributed | ai-inferred | human-inferred | structural | pre-ai
CAVEAT: entries are keyed by SHA, and this repository's branches do get
rebased, which rewrites SHAs. An override whose SHA no longer exists is
silently inert — it does not error. Prefer fixing the commit trailer at the
time of writing over correcting it here afterwards.
